metadata.time_note: Storm Data entry times should be reviewed in local Standard Time (ST), not daylight time. Candidate reports include standard_time_display.
metadata.tornado_track_policy: Tornado tracks must come from DAT. NCEI begin/end coordinates are not used as a tornado track substitute.

properties.event_narrative: A maximum tide level of 7.04 ft MLLW (1.28 ft MHHW) was observed at the Charleston Harbor tide gage. Shallow coastal flooding typically begins along the coasts of Charleston and Colleton counties when tide levels reach 7.0 ft MLLW (1.24 ft MHHW) in the Charleston Harbor.
